projects.title: Click as a Pro
projects.description:
A collection of work for IPKO, the second largest mobile telephony in the country, during 2013-2022.

Click as a Pro

Ipko is one of the largest telecommunications companies in Kosova, and is growing fast in Europe. Over the years it has brought various offers to our market, trying to meet the telecommunication needs of individuals and businesses. This year, this company asked us to realize a promotional advertisement for Pako PRO, a package targeting businesses. We produced a TV commercial with a very creative approach. 

The ad was shot with the one-shot technique which is a famous technique…
